name: singer
title: My Song

character.name: Singer
character.description: Singer, a young woman who sings lead: long straight silver hair, a red bomber jacket, black jeans. Describe what the character sheet shows.

face.description: Close-up of Singer's face: long straight silver hair, grey eyes, red lipstick.

location.name: Street
location.description: A night street with neon signs in pink and cyan, wet pavement reflecting the lights.

look: Photorealistic city-pop music-video look: rich pink, magenta and cyan neon, warm golden shop light, soft bloom around the lights, 35mm film grain, realistic skin and fabric texture.
idea: Singer performs her song on a neon street at night in a vertical music video, the camera moving around her from changing angles.
common: From the very first frame she is already standing close to the lens. The camera never goes behind her; her face always stays in view. @Singer sings the song with a light groove on the spot; her lips follow the vocals and stay closed when there are no vocals. The place is always the @Street.
intro: The camera frames @Singer's face and shoulders on the @Street, 85mm lens, from the very first frame. She waits for the song with her lips closed, swaying gently. 0–5s: She looks up into the lens with a small smile. 5–10s: She breathes in, about to sing.
shots: The camera frames @Singer from her head to her waist, slightly from her left, 35mm lens at chest height. The camera slowly orbits from her front-left to her front.
She sings to the lens with small shoulder bounces.
She keeps singing to the lens, one hand loose at her side.
The camera frames a close-up of @Singer's face and shoulders, 85mm lens, with the pink neon at the left edge. The camera pushes in very slowly.
She sings softly to the lens, eyes half closed.
She opens her eyes and keeps singing to the lens with a small smile.
The camera frames @Singer from her head to her waist from a low angle, 24mm lens, the neon signs above her. The camera rises smoothly to her eye level.
She sings down to the lens with a finger snap on the beat.
She keeps singing straight into the lens, a hand on her hip.
